cases.sentence: Радостная ___ о царстве будет возвещена по всему миру.
cases.translation: This good news of the kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world.
cases.explain: Весть is the subject of the passive verb будет возвещена (will be proclaimed), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: И от ___ зла во многих охладеет любовь, но тот, кто выстоит до конца, будет спасен.
cases.translation: And because of the increase of wickedness, the love of many will grow cold, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
cases.explain: The preposition от (because of, from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Радостная весть о царстве будет возвещена по всему ___.
cases.translation: This good news of the kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world.
cases.explain: The preposition по meaning 'throughout' governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Кто окажется на крыше, пусть не спускается в ___ за вещами.
cases.translation: Let him who is on the roof not go down into the house to get his belongings.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative; for the inanimate masculine дом the accusative equals the nominative.

cases.translation: Let the fig tree be an example for you.
cases.explain: The verb быть (to be) requires its predicate noun in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Итак, когда вы увидите на святом ___ опустошающую мерзость, о которой говорил пророк Даниил, пусть читающий поймет.
cases.translation: So when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of through the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place, let the reader understand.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location (in the holy place) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: «Говорю вам истину, здесь не останется и камня на камне, все будет разрушено».
reading.question: What did Jesus predict about the temple buildings?
options: Not one stone would be left on another; all would be destroyed
They would be rebuilt even grander
They would be turned into a marketplace
reading.correct: Not one stone would be left on another; all would be destroyed
reading.explain: Jesus said 'здесь не останется и камня на камне, все будет разрушено' (not one stone will be left on another; all will be thrown down).

reading.ru: Потому что многие будут приходить под Моим именем, говоря, «Я Христос», и многих обманут.
reading.question: What warning did Jesus give about people coming in his name?
options: Many would falsely claim to be the Christ and deceive many
Many would come bearing gifts for the temple
Many would come to defend Jerusalem
reading.correct: Many would falsely claim to be the Christ and deceive many
reading.explain: Jesus warned many would come saying '«Я Христос»' (I am the Christ) 'и многих обманут' (and deceive many).

reading.ru: Потому что народ поднимется на народ, и царство на царство.
reading.question: What sign of the coming end does Jesus mention regarding nations?
options: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom
All nations will unite in peace
One kingdom will rule the entire earth
reading.correct: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom
reading.explain: Jesus says 'народ поднимется на народ, и царство на царство' (nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom).

reading.ru: И от умножения зла во многих охладеет любовь, но тот, кто выстоит до конца, будет спасен.
reading.question: What does Jesus say will happen to love as wickedness increases?
options: The love of many will grow cold, but whoever endures to the end will be saved
Love will grow stronger among believers
Love will disappear entirely from the earth
Love will be replaced by fear of God alone
reading.correct: The love of many will grow cold, but whoever endures to the end will be saved
reading.explain: The text says 'от умножения зла во многих охладеет любовь, но тот, кто выстоит до конца, будет спасен' (because of the increase of wickedness the love of many will grow cold, but he who endures to the end will be saved).

reading.ru: Тогда те, кто находится в Иудее, пусть бегут в горы.
reading.question: What does Jesus tell those in Judea to do when they see the abomination of desolation?
reading.explain: Jesus says 'те, кто находится в Иудее, пусть бегут в горы' (those in Judea should flee to the mountains).

reading.ru: И если бы те дни не были сокращены, то не уцелело бы ни одно живое существо, но ради избранных они будут сокращены.
reading.question: Why will the days of great suffering be shortened, according to Jesus?
options: For the sake of the chosen ones
Because the temple will be rebuilt
Because the disciples asked for mercy
reading.correct: For the sake of the chosen ones
reading.explain: The text says those days will be shortened 'ради избранных' (for the sake of the chosen ones).

reading.ru: потому что как молния, которая, сверкая с востока, бывает видна и на западе, так будет и возвращение Сына Человеческого.
reading.question: How does Jesus describe the coming of the Son of Man?
options: Like lightning that flashes from the east and is visible in the west
Like a whisper heard only by a few
Like a slow sunrise over the mountains
Like a trumpet heard only in Jerusalem
reading.correct: Like lightning that flashes from the east and is visible in the west
reading.explain: Jesus compares his coming to 'молния, которая, сверкая с востока, бывает видна и на западе' (lightning that flashes from the east and is seen even in the west).

reading.ru: Они увидят Сына Человеческого, идущего на небесных облаках, с силой и великой славой.
reading.question: How will people see the Son of Man arrive?
options: Coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory
Riding on a white horse alone
reading.correct: Coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory
reading.explain: The text says they will see the Son of Man 'идущего на небесных облаках, с силой и великой славой' (coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory).

reading.ru: Еще не исчезнет это поколение, как все это произойдет.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about when these things will occur?
options: This generation will not pass away before all these things happen
It will take thousands of years to occur
Only future generations will witness it
No one will ever see it happen
reading.correct: This generation will not pass away before all these things happen
reading.explain: Jesus says 'Еще не исчезнет это поколение, как все это произойдет' (this generation will not pass away before all these things happen).

reading.ru: Но о том дне и часе не знает никто, кроме Отца, ни ангела на небесах, ни Сын.
reading.question: Who, according to Jesus, knows the day and hour of his return?
reading.explain: Jesus says 'о том дне и часе не знает никто, кроме Отца' (about that day and hour no one knows, except the Father).

reading.ru: Он рассечет его надвое и определит ему одну участь с лицемерами.
reading.question: What happens to the wicked servant in Jesus' parable?
options: He is cut in two and assigned a place with the hypocrites
He is forgiven and given more responsibility
He is sent away to another country
He is imprisoned until his master returns
reading.correct: He is cut in two and assigned a place with the hypocrites
reading.explain: The text says the master 'рассечет его надвое и определит ему одну участь с лицемерами' (will cut him in two and assign him a place with the hypocrites).
